factual_claims.claim: Ambu delivered a solid start to 2025/26, with Q1 revenue of DKK 1,558m, up 3.2% on a reported basis and 8.6% organically from DKK 1,510m in Q1 2024/25.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue increased organically by 8.6% (19.5%) to DKK 1,558m (DKK 1,510m), with reported growth of 3.2% (20.4%).

factual_claims.claim: Organic growth was lower than the previous year’s 19.5%, reflecting high comparables, while foreign exchange reduced reported growth by 5.4 percentage points.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Endoscopy Solutions remained the main growth engine, generating 63% of revenue and 14.4% organic growth, compared with 20.6% in the prior-year quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Endoscopy Solutions increased organically by 14.4% (20.6%). Revenue split: 986m DKK (63% of total 1,558m).

factual_claims.claim: Respiratory grew organically by 8.3%, supported by continued adoption of aScope 5 Broncho and the launch of the SureSight video laryngoscope solution.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Respiratory business group posted 8.3% (17.7%) organic growth, driven by aScope 5 Broncho adoption and SureSight video laryngoscope launch.

factual_claims.claim: Urology, ENT, & GI recorded particularly strong organic growth of 21.0%, driven mainly by the aScope 4 portfolio and continued momentum for aScope 5 Uretero; growth also benefited from some orders typically expected in Q2.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Urology, ENT, & GI business group posted 21.0% (23.9%) organic growth, mainly driven by aScope 4 portfolio; Q1 growth benefitted from orders that typically are part of Q2.

factual_claims.claim: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring was broadly flat, with organic growth of -0.1% versus 17.8% last year, reflecting an exceptionally high prior-year revenue base.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% (17.8%), reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue achieved in the same quarter last year.

factual_claims.claim: North America and Europe grew organically by 9.8% and 9.7%, respectively, while Rest of World declined 1.6% because of order fluctuations and high comparables.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: North America: 9.8% organic growth. Europe: 9.7% organic growth. Rest of World: -1.6% organic growth due to order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from last year.

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBIT margin b.s.i. decreased to 10.5% from 16.1%; net profit decreased to DKK 118m from DKK 183m.

factual_claims.claim: EBIT before special items fell to DKK 164m from DKK 243m, and the EBIT margin decreased to 10.5% from 16.1%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBIT before special items (b.s.i.) was DKK 164m (DKK 243m), with an EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5% (16.1%).

factual_claims.claim: Tariff costs of more than DKK 50m and foreign-exchange headwinds were the principal reported pressures; excluding these effects, the EBIT margin was 15.2%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5%... Adjusting for tariff costs and FX, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2% in the quarter, demonstrating continued operational leverage... tariff costs amounting to more than DKK 50m, and FX headwind representing the remaining impact.

factual_claims.claim: The gross margin declined slightly to 60.8% from 61.3%, while the operating-expense ratio increased to 50.3% from 45.2%, partly because of continued investment in commercial infrastructure and the inclusion of tariff costs in operating expenses.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Gross margin in Q1 2025/26 was 60.8%, corresponding to a decline of 0.5%-pts, compared to Q1 2024/25... OPEX to revenue in Q1 2025/26 was 50.3%, corresponding to an increase of 5.1%-pts, compared to Q1 2024/25... tariff costs are included under OPEX...

factual_claims.claim: Net profit decreased to DKK 118m from DKK 183m, and EPS fell to DKK 0.44 from DKK 0.68.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net profit for the period: 118 DKKm (183 DKKm). Earnings per share: 0.44 DKK (0.68 DKK).

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating cash flow declined to DKK 106m from DKK 144m; free cash flow before acquisitions fell to DKK 13m from DKK 69m.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow declined to DKK 106m from DKK 144m, and free cash flow before acquisitions fell to DKK 13m from DKK 69m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow from operating activities (CFFO): 106 DKKm (144 DKKm). Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions: 13 DKKm (69 DKKm).

factual_claims.claim: The main drag was an adverse DKK 107m change in working capital, as inventories and working capital remained elevated to support growth and mitigate global geopolitical uncertainties.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions totaled DKK 13m... mainly negatively impacted by a change in net working capital, which remained elevated... Change in working capital: -107 DKKm.

factual_claims.claim: Ambu paid DKK 110m in dividends and repurchased DKK 38m of treasury shares during the quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Ambu paid out DKK 90m in dividend in Q1... DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares in Q1 as part of Ambu’s share buyback program.

factual_claims.claim: The company maintained its full-year guidance for 10–13% organic revenue growth, a 12–14% EBIT margin before special items, and cash conversion above 40%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025/26 financial guidance maintained: Organic revenue growth: 10-13%. EBIT margin before special items: 12-14%. Cash conversion: +40%.

factual_claims.claim: Growth and margin are expected to be higher in the second half of the financial year, while tariffs are expected to reduce the EBIT margin by approximately two percentage points under current assumptions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Growth and EBIT margin are still expected to be higher in H2 compared to H1... 14-16% excluding assumed impacts of ~2%-pts given the current schedule of expected tariffs.
